topics.title: Mammachi's pickle business and Pappachi's retirement

concepts.learning_objective: Recall how Mammachi's pickle and jam business began and grew.
Explain why Pappachi felt retirement as a humiliation and resented his wife's success.

topics.title: Cruelty at home, Chacko's intervention and the Plymouth

concepts.learning_objective: Describe Pappachi's violence and how Chacko put an end to it.
Interpret how Pappachi used his public image and the Plymouth to punish his family.

topics.title: The moth that was not named after him

concepts.learning_objective: Recall how Pappachi found the moth and what was first decided about it.
Analyse why the later reclassification became his life's greatest setback.

topics.title: Vienna, the violin and Pappachi's death

concepts.learning_objective: Explain why Mammachi's violin lessons in Vienna were abruptly stopped.
Interpret Ammu's comment on habit and the irony in the account of Pappachi's death.

topics.title: About the author and language work
topics.ncert_sections: About the Author; Language Work; Reading for the Blind

concepts.learning_objective: Identify Arundhati Roy and the novel from which the extract is taken.
Match kinds of scientists and kinds of writing with their meanings.
Interpret the account of how the Braille system developed from night writing.
